tools.name: check_dataset_quality
tools.description: Call this before using any dataset. Returns a deterministic quality verdict (RELIABLE / USABLE_WITH_CLEANING / UNRELIABLE) with exact facts: completeness, nulls, type consistency, impossible values, duplicates, outliers, and (on financial/trading data) cross-source price divergence. 100% determinist

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "check_dataset_quality" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Call this before using any dataset. Returns a deterministic quality verdict (RELIABLE / USABLE_WITH_CLEANING / UNRELIABLE) with exact facts: completeness, nulls…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp_server" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_dataset_quality · Public sink: check_dataset_quality.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_dataset_quality · Public sink: check_dataset_quality

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
